title: Asiad: Rianne Malixi fires 66 to stay in medal chase
summary: Teenager Rianne Malixi is in the mix for a medal in women's golf in the 2026 Asian Games after carding a four-under 66 in the second round on Thursday at the Kasugai Country Club East Course.
